dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular network of light-colored, high-contrast perimeters forming incomplete 'O' and 'C' shapes with sharp gradient transitions from light exterior boundaries to darker, low-intensity interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of high-intensity white punctate clusters, with the most prominent single-pixel concentration located superior to the right pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal rings form an irregular pentagonal relationship, while three smaller clusters near the posterior-lateral margin form a narrow scalene triangle.
